settings.text: The Best Men’s Holiday Gifts from Zero Restriction

settings.richtext:
Give him the gift of premium performance. Explore top picks from versatile activewear to best-in-class rain gear, and everything in between.

Need a gift for her? Discover our top 10 for her

settings.title: Z700 Full Zip Vest
settings.content: A best seller for a reason. Designed for everyday wear, this vest is a lightweight, windproof, and water-repellent layer you can wear in any weather, in any season—even in the summer. It's made with four-way stretch fabric that moves with you while you play, and it’s equally comfortable for the course or your commute.

settings.title: TKO Hoodie
settings.content: TKO stands for Technical Knockout, and that’s exactly what this hoodie is. The modern, motion-tuned sweatshirt is engineered to keep you warm and fully mobile, whether you’re layering up for your next round or your next coffee run. In our signature performance spacer-knit fabric, it’s breathable, quick-drying, and light as air—and it might just be the softest hoodie you’ve ever felt.

settings.title: Rain Gloves
settings.content: The rain gloves you've been looking for. Made from best-in-class leather with a superior grip, they're windproof, rainproof, and come with a removable ball marker that'll always come in handy.

settings.title: Bucket Hat
settings.content: The final touch, this bucket hat ensures complete waterproofness and freedom to fight the elements.

settings.title: Z2000 Jacket
settings.content: The best rain jacket on the market. This industry leader is 100% seam-sealed, with three layers of breathable waterproofing technology guaranteed to last for life. No detail is spared—from the dual-direction zippers that prevent fabric from bunching, to our adjustable “dot-lock” cuffs that hold well and never fray. One final mention? Its stretch shell ensures zero restriction.

settings.title: The Summit
settings.content: Peak performance. Reach for our Summit Jacket and you’ll get a grey goose down-filled, water-repellent, and fully lined layer with all the features you need to reach new heights. Superior thermal regulation keeps you warm in any conditions, down to the snug wrist cuffs and adjustable drawcord hood. Versatile and practical, take it with you on every adventure.

settings.title: Jim Hoodie
settings.content: Run, lift, repeat. Right at home in the gym, Jim is your new favorite activewear layer. Extremely lightweight and moisture-wicking, it’s made with stretch fabric that moves with you from one workout to the next. With its classic, casual hoodie aesthetic, keep it on for wherever the rest of your day takes you—you won’t want to take it off.

settings.title: Power Torque Full ZIp
settings.content: A durable, waterproof jacket designed to keep up with you. Rainproof coating and a multi-layer construction keep you dry and protected, and our unique Power Torque Technology ensures restriction-free movement. A few finishing touches? Adjustable cuffs, waterproof zippers, and a comfortable anti-chafe chin guard.

settings.title: Z2000 Pant 2.0
settings.content: Discover best-in-class waterproofing, guaranteed to last for life. These rain pants keep you protected and ready to play at any time. Their elastic waist slides on easily over your original shorts or pants, and they feature pass-through zippers to reach your pockets underneath. Rain gutters and ankle snaps keep you fully dry, and a lightweight, motion-tuned design offers easy movement. Industry-leading for a reason, they’re a stormproof staple you’ll always want on-hand.

settings.title: Z625 Vest
settings.content: A quilted essential. This lightweight layer is windproof and motion-tuned, keeping you comfortable on the course while moving and stretching with you. Engineered with all the thoughtful details—from the zippered valuables pocket to the anti-chafe chin guard—it’s a best-selling favorite for multi-season wear.
